title: Configuration from Three Buffers
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $y$ be an input list, let $s$ be a state of the tabulating machine built from $M$, and let $p$ be an input-head position among the $|y|+2$ positions. Given three Boolean lists $w_X,w_C,w_O$, form the configuration with state $s$, input position $p$, blank original work tapes at position zero, and auxiliary tapes encoding these three lists with their heads at positions $|w_X|,|w_C|,|w_O|$, respectively; the output is empty.
